newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks at new intraday record, breach 4,400.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks at new intraday record, breach 4,400.

text.p: Mexican stocks continued their week-long charge into record territory in early trade Friday, when they broached the 4,400-point barrier for the first time ever.

Dealers said domestic and foreign investors were buying in the wake of a recent crop of positive economic data heralding an economic recovery, and increasingly confident market sentiment over forthcoming mid-term elections.
The blue chip IPC share index .MXX was up 47.30 points, or 1.09 percent, at a new trading record of 4,400.97.
